title.zh-CN: 反复咳嗽咯血与右肺门病灶 · 55岁女性
title.en: Recurrent cough, haemoptysis and a right hilar lesion · woman aged 55

summary.zh-CN: 反复短程抗菌后改善又复发的肺部占位，需要病理和微生物证据而非只凭影像定性。
summary.en: A mass-like pulmonary lesion repeatedly improves and relapses after antibiotics; tissue and microbiology are needed.

provenance.citation: 牟向东, 章巍, 曹菊, 陈建, 聂立功, 熊焰, 高莉, 王广发. 肺放线菌病一例. 中华结核和呼吸杂志. 2013;36(08):617-619. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.1001-0939.2013.08.018.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 咳嗽带血6年，加重伴发热20天

triageNote.zh-CN: 发热最高39℃，咳嗽咳痰并轻度气促。
triageNote.en: Fever up to 39°C, productive cough and mild dyspnoea.

answer.en: Intermittent cough with blood-streaked sputum for six years, once or twice yearly.

name.zh-CN: 复发后颗粒及染色复核

zh-CN: 复发后颗粒及染色复核

text.zh-CN: 黄色颗粒堵塞支气管；硫磺颗粒周围放射状菌丝，革兰及银染阳性、抗酸及弱抗酸阴性，两次标本专科鉴定放线菌。
text.en: Yellow granules obstructed the bronchus; sulphur granules with radiating filaments were Gram/silver positive and acid-fast/modified acid-fast negative. Specialist review identified Actinomyces in both specimens.

text.zh-CN: 原报告米诺环素因色素沉着及胃肠反应停用，改阿奇霉素6个月；病灶基本吸收伴轻度支扩，停药后未再复发，但随访长度不详。
text.en: Minocycline was stopped for pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects, followed by six months of azithromycin. Lesions largely resolved with mild bronchiectasis and no reported recurrence over unspecified follow-up.

prompt.zh-CN: 影像缩小但反复复发应如何判断？
prompt.en: How should shrinking but recurrent mass-like disease be interpreted?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 慢性感染需进一步取证，同时不能仅凭一次阴性细胞排除肿瘤
text.en: Seek evidence for chronic infection without excluding tumour from one negative sample

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗反应、菌团和复发应整合复核。

text.zh-CN: 肺门肿块已等于肺癌确诊
text.en: A hilar mass alone confirms lung cancer

feedback.zh-CN: 病原和组织证据尚需比较。
feedback.en: Microbial and tissue evidence must be compared.

text.zh-CN: 影像缩小即证明已完全根除感染
text.en: Radiological shrinkage proves eradication

feedback.zh-CN: 后续复发已显示这一推断过强。
feedback.en: Recurrence demonstrates that this inference is too strong.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 组织形态和染色组合支持肺放线菌病
text.en: Tissue morphology and stain pattern support pulmonary actinomycosis

feedback.zh-CN: 弱抗酸阴性及菌丝形态有助与诺卡菌等鉴别。
feedback.en: Modified acid-fast negativity and morphology help distinguish alternatives such as Nocardia.

text.zh-CN: 既往结核使所有现病灶必为结核
text.en: Previous TB makes every new lesion tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 既往标签不能代替当前病原证据。
feedback.en: A previous diagnosis cannot replace current evidence.

text.zh-CN: 只要银染阳性就必为真菌
text.en: Any positive silver stain proves a fungus

feedback.zh-CN: 需要形态、其他染色及微生物复核。
feedback.en: Morphology, other stains and microbiological review are required.

prompt.zh-CN: 有抗菌药过敏史时怎样制定计划？
prompt.en: How should the allergy history inform planning?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 感染团队核实过敏反应、病原及耐受情况，制定疗程和影像随访
text.en: Infectious-disease review should clarify allergy, organism and tolerability and plan duration and imaging

feedback.zh-CN: 不把单例阿奇霉素成功外推为通用首选。
feedback.en: One reported azithromycin success does not establish a universal first choice.

text.zh-CN: 忽略过敏史直接照用青霉素
text.en: Ignore allergy and directly prescribe penicillin

feedback.zh-CN: 反应类型和可用方案需专业评估。
feedback.en: Reaction type and options require specialist assessment.

text.zh-CN: 症状一好就永久停药停随访
text.en: Stop treatment and follow-up permanently when symptoms improve

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：将反复短程改善与复发纳入感染鉴别。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：明确菌种培养与药敏、过敏反应类型、长期随访。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Use repeated transient improvement and relapse in the infection differential. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Species culture/susceptibility, allergy reaction details and long-term follow-up. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 反复肺占位经组织形态及专科复核诊断肺放线菌病。
conclusion.en: Recurrent mass-like pulmonary disease was identified as actinomycosis through tissue morphology and specialist review.

boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

testUtterances.text: 咳嗽带血多久了，一年发几次？
How long has the blood-streaked cough occurred, and how often?
这是不是以前也反复发生过？
Has this happened repeatedly before?
这次什么时候加重，有没有气短？
When did this episode worsen, and is there breathlessness?
最近一次发烧咳嗽与以前有什么不同？
How does this febrile cough compare with earlier episodes?
以前抗生素治疗后能好多久？
How did earlier episodes respond to antibiotics?
这次用药后发热和影像有变化吗？
Did fever and imaging change after this treatment?
对哪些抗生素过敏，反应是什么？
Which antibiotics caused allergy, and what reaction occurred?
以前用青霉素或头孢出过问题吗？
Have penicillin or cephalosporins caused problems before?
以前肺部做过什么手术？
What previous lung operation was performed?
那次肺手术病理怎么说？
What did the pathology from that lung operation show?
糖尿病诊断多久了？
How long ago was diabetes diagnosed?
以前有多长时间的糖尿病？
How long has diabetes been present?
有没有吸烟或饮酒？
Is there smoking or alcohol use?
烟酒的用量和时间有记录吗？
Are amounts and duration of smoking or alcohol recorded?
以前有没有青霉素头孢过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any penicillin and cephalosporin allergy?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
以前有没有既往健康情况方面的情况？
Could you describe any previous health?
